description: 한국환경공단_도로 재비산먼지 측정정보 조회서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경공단. 한국환경공단도로 재비산먼지 측정 정보 조회서비스는 특수제작한 이동측정차량으로 주행하는 차량의 타이어(휠)와 도로면의 마찰에 의해서 재비산되는 먼지(PM10)를 측정한 정보 입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경공단. Its tags are 도로재비산, 이동측정차량, 재비산먼지, PM10, 미세먼지 저감. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
